title: Q-TRAJ-neglected-docs-runbooks: docs/runbooks had 134 lines of change, then nothing for 8 days while the rest of the system moved
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** trajectory pass (TRAJECTORY-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:docs/runbooks
**Status:** closed

docs/runbooks had 134 lines of change, then nothing for 8 days while the rest of the system moved. Evidence: quiet_days 8; system change in the last 7 days 227214.

Find why it went quiet while the system moved: a loop that no longer fires, an area nothing consumes. Fix the loop or retire the area with a recorded disposition.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation trajectory --probe neglected:docs/runbooks` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-22T01:33:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
